title: SMS-Based Remote Symptom Monitoring for Patients With Plasma Cell Disorders
official: SMS-Based Remote Symptom Monitoring for Patients With Plasma Cell Disorders
summary: This study evaluates whether daily SMS-based (text messages) symptom monitoring is feasible and acceptable in patients who are undergoing treatment for multiple myeloma (MM) or systemic light chain amyloidosis (AL), and whether it can help in early identification of symptoms that may require clinical attention.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \>= 18 years
* Diagnosis of MM or AL based on IMWG diagnostic criteria
* Planned to start a new treatment within 14 days (+/-7 days)
* Able to provide written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not able to give informed consent
